|value = 200 |gprice = 2500 }} The '''Jade Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|2500}} after completing the [[Quests#Deeper In The Mine|Deeper in the Mine]] Quest. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es. The Jade Ring increases [[Crit. Power|critical strike power]] by 10% while equipped. Equipping a second Jade Ring adds a further 10% critical strike power, for a total 20% increase. ==Dyeing== It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==References== Ring::AddEquipmentEffects is called once for each equipped ring by BuffManager::GetValues. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Jade-Ring]] [[es:Anillo de jade]] [[fr:Bague de jade]] [[it:Anello di giada]] [[ja:ヒスイの指輪]] [[ko:옥 반지]] [[hu:Jáde gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de jade]] [[ru:Кольцо с нефритом]] [[tr:Yeşim Yüzük]] [[zh:翡翠戒指]]
